paraphrase: Because there is buddha within birth and death there is no birth and death; this birth-and-death is the life of the buddha; if one hates and discards it one loses the buddha's life; simply release body and mind, throw them into the house of the buddha, and without effort one becomes buddha.
speaker: Dōgen
notes: From memory; the text is not held locally, so no original is quoted and section labels are descriptive.
